title: ConfiguredProduct
description: Product as it is currently configured on the storefront. The configuration changes each time the shopper changes the product order.

availableShippingDiscounts.description: List of potential shipping discounts available for this product.

fulfillmentTypesSupported.description: Indicates the fulfillment types the product supports.

options.description: Remaining options and option values that can be selected given the shopper's current selection of options.

productCode.description: Merchant-created code associated with the product, for example, a SKU.

properties.description: Remaining options and option values that can be selected given the shopper's current selection of options.

purchaseLocation.description:
The location where the product is being purchased.. default is null. Products can have different prices
by purchaseLocation via custom priceListResolution....

variationProductCode.description:
For a product with options, the code of the product variation that represents the current selection of product options. 
Question: is this right?

volumePriceBands.description: For products with bulk pricing... this will be populated with pricebands, depending on what options have been selected...

AttributeDetail.description: Product Attribute properties common between a Product Propery, Option, and Extra

allowFilteringAndSortingInStorefront.description: Indicates whether the attribute should be able to be used in filters, facets, and sorting on the public storefront.

availableForOrderRouting.description: Indicates whether the attribute is available for order routing

customWeightInStorefrontSearch.description: Indicates whether the attribtue value is indexed so that it can have a custom relevency weight compared to other attributes in a tokenized text search

dataType.description: The DataType of the attribute. Valid values for DataType are defined in DataTypeTypeConst.

dataTypeSequence.description: A unique sequence of the attribute By dataType (used for common naming of fields in search index)

description.description: Description of the attribute in the language specified by LocaleCode.

displayIntention.description: Am optional hint to the theme about how this attribute should be displayed (what control to use)

indexValueWithCase.description: Indicates whether the attribtue value is indexed with case or not

inputType.description: The InputType type of the attribute. Valid values for InputType are defined in InputTypeConst.

name.description: Name of the attribute in the language specified by LocaleCode.

searchDisplayValue.description:
If true, the system will index the display value of string attributes instead of the canonical value for searching. 
The canonical value will always be used for filtering. Does not apply for for non-string attributes.

searchableInStorefront.description: Indicates whether the attribute value is searchable.

usageType.description: The UsageType of the attribute. Valid values for the usageType are defined in UsageTypeConst .

valueType.description: The ValueType of the attribute. Valid values for ValueType are defined in ValueTypeTypeConst.

couponCode.description: If the discount is a coupon, code associated with the coupon.

impact.description: The new calculated price of the product. That is, the product price minus the discount amount.

maxDateValue.description: For validating a DateTime attribute value, maximum datetime allowed.

maxNumericValue.description: For validating Number attribute value, maximum number allowed.

maxStringLength.description: For validating strings, maximum length allowed for a string.

minDateValue.description: For validating a DateTime attribute value, minimum datetime allowed.

minNumericValue.description: For validating Number attribute value, minimum number allowed.

minStringLength.description: For validating strings, minimum length allowed for a string.

regularExpression.description: Regular expression to run against the attribute value. This should follow JavaScript/EMCA's Regular Expression syntax.

CatalogRuntimesAttributeVocabularyValueD.description: Product Attribute properties common between a Product Propery, Option, and Extra

cmsId.description: Id of the image in the CMS.

colorValue.description: Hex Color value to display in a color picker

creditValue.description: Credit Value applicable to this product. Should only be present on DigitalCredit goodsType....

goodsType.description: The GoodsType of this product (Physical, Digital, DigitalCredit)

isPackagedStandAlone.description: Is this product shipped in its own package

optionAttributeFQN.description: Fully Qualified Name of the selected option's attribute (only applies to Products as extras)

optionValue.description: Value of the selected option (only applies to Products as extras)

productCode.description: Merchant-created code associated with the product, for example, a SKU.

quantity.description: The quantity of the bundled product

impact.description: The Impact of the individual Discount

CatalogRuntimesPackageMeasurements.description: Physical dimensions of the package required to ship the product and its weight.

CatalogRuntimesProductInventoryInfo.description: Use the Products resource to create and manage products for your store. You can create products with options that a shopper configures (such as a T-shirt color and size). The system can manage inventory for all combinations of your product options, and can calculate tax and shipping costs.

availableDate.description: Date the item will become available for back order if out of stock

isSubstitutable.description: ReadOnly flag indicates is the product has substitutions defined

manageStock.description: If true, the Products service manages inventory for this product.

onlineSoftStockAvailable.description: Number of product items currently available for purchase.

onlineStockAvailable.description: Number of product items currently available for purchase.

outOfStockBehavior.description: The behvior when the ManageStock is true and the product is not in stock.

CatalogRuntimesProductOption.description: An option for a product and its list of values, if any. Also includes whether the option is configurable or stand-alone, whether it is required, whether it can have mulitple values and whether the shopper can supply its value (for example, engraved initials).

isMultiValue.description: If true, more than one value can be assigned to an option. Only possible with stand-alone options.

isRequired.description: If true, the shopper must provide a value for the option before it can be purchased.

values.description: Possible choices for an option, for example, values of the option "Color" can be "red," "white," and "blue."

deltaPrice.description: How much this option costs above the cost of the product.

deltaWeight.description: How much this option weighs above the weight of the product.

isDefault.description: If true, this is the default value that the merchant supplied.

isEnabled.description: If true, this option is enabled and can be selected. During configuration, this returns false of this option value is invalid with other current selected options.

isSelected.description: If true, this is the option that is currently selected. It can be either the default value or one that the shopper has selected.

shopperEnteredValue.description: How much this option costs above the cost of the product.

stringValue.description: Localized Value in the language of the locale code only available for dataType string

CatalogRuntimesProductPrice.description: Price of the product with any sale and discounts applied.

catalogListPrice.description: Current Price Listed in the catalog.

catalogSalePrice.description: Current sale price of the product listed in the catalog. This is not typically dispalyed directly to the user as it will be listed in SalePrice if applicable.

creditValue.description: Credit Value applicable to this product. Should only be present on DigitalCredit goodsType....

effectivePricelistCode.description: The priceList that was applied to this product

msrp.description: Manufacturer suggested Retail price, this may be null if one is not set in the catalog.

price.description: Listed Price of the product. This is the price that the merchant intends to sell the product for if no sale is active.

priceListEntryCode.description: The specific PriceListCode that was applied (includes inheritence

priceListEntryMode.description: IF a PriceList Entry was applied to this price it will be (simple, bulk...)

priceType.description: Futher clarification of what value is being returned in the Price field

salePrice.description: Current sale price of the product. This can be either a specific numerical amount or it can be calculated based on an active discount. Optional.

CatalogRuntimesProductProperty.description: An attribute used as a property of a product

isHidden.description: Indicates whether the product property should be hidden from the customer

isMultiValue.description: Indicates whether it's possible for there to be more than one value in the Values field

stringValue.description: Localized Value in the language of the locale code

ProductContent.description: Name of the product and, if supplied, description, metatags, friendly URL, and associated images.

metaTagDescription.description: Metadata description used to manage information internally.

metaTagKeywords.description: Metadata keywords used to manage information internally.

metaTagTitle.description: Metadata title used to manage information internally.

productFullDescription.description: Detailed description of the product typically used for a product details page.

productShortDescription.description: Brief description of the product typically used when the product is displayed in a list or search results.

seoFriendlyUrl.description: Human-readable identifier defined for the product to create friendly URLs.

ProductImage.description: Image or video associated with a product.

altText.description: Descriptive text associated with the image. Unicode data with a maximum length of 200 characters.

cmsId.description: Id of the image in the CMS.

imageLabel.description: Image title.  Unicode data with a maximum length of 50 characters.

imageUrl.description: Image URL. Unicode data with a maximum length of 4000 characters.

mediaType.description: Type of media. Used by the client to determine how to render the image or video or what have you.

sequence.description: For products with multiple images, the sequence is the order in which this image appears. Whole number data. Required.

videoUrl.description: URL of the video. Unicode data with a maximum length of 4000 characters.

ProductPriceRange.description: For products with options that vary the cost of the product, the range between lowest and highest possible price of the product based on the current selection of options.

ProductPurchasableState.description: Current state of the product purchase, that is, whether it is ready to be purchased. For products with configurable options,     /// the product is purchaseable if the shopper has selected all required options. If not, a message lists which required options are missing.

isPurchasable.description: If true, this product is currently available for purchase. For products with options, this is false until the shopper selects all required options.

messages.description: Message associated with this product if it is not ready to be purchased. For products with options, message contains which required options are missing.

message.description: Message displayed to the user when this validation failure occurred.

severity.description:
Severity level of the validation failure.
 Must be one of the values in SeverityConst.

source.description: What invoked the validation.  Must be one of the values in SourceTypeConst.

sourceId.description: Unique identifier of the source that invoked the validation failure.

validationType.description:
Type of validation error that occurred. This can be checked programatically. 
 Must be one of the values in ValidationTypeConst.
